body.condition: There exist a standard Borel measurable space \((\mathcal V,\mathscr V)\), a \(\mathcal V\)-valued random element \(V\), a jointly measurable map \(h:\mathcal A\times\mathcal X\times\mathcal V\to[-B_Y,B_Y]\), and one measurable event \(\Omega_0\) such that \(V\perp A\mid X\), \(P(\Omega_0)=1\), and \(Y(a,\omega)=h(a,X(\omega),V(\omega))\) for every \(\omega\in\Omega_0\) and every \(a\in\mathcal A\).
